title.narrative: Rural Advisory Services for Women Empowerment (RAS4WE)

description.narrative: Overall objectives/Impact: The socio-economic situation of economically vulnerable and politically marginalised women in the rural district of Sirajganj in the Char region has improvedOutcome: 3,000 marginalised women in Sirajganj district are increasingly accessing quality counselling services, are more involved in local decision-making processes and benefit from improved employment and income

The Rural Advisory Services for Women Empowerment in the Char Region of Bangladesh (RASWE) will be implemented jointly by FIVDB and Uttaran in areas of Sirajganj District. The overall objective is to contribute to economically empowering women that are exposed to economic vulnerability and political marginalisation. This will be achieved by improving women's income and employment opportunities through promoting rural advisory services, agro-entrepreneurship, and a strengthened women-led civil society on the local level. The project will cover a direct target group consists of 3,000 women farmers /entrepreneurs and 100 Women Community Service Providers (CSP) belonging to 100 villages situated in the District of Sirajganj. These project participants will form entrepreneur groups/MSME which will in turn be linked to 50 Rural Service Centres 20 Community Facility Centres and 2 women-led civil society organisationsmore that will benefit from improved advisory services and income opportunities. All of these groups will benefit from an improved enabling environment that includes the engagement of market actors, local government, and civil society. In order to make these changes sustainable, the project pursues an integrated, multi-stakeholder, gender-transformative approach in communities and households, that will strengthen women’s market participation, income, and agency to act as agents of change for their communities.

The direct target group consists of 3,000 women farmers /entrepreneurs and 100 Women Community Service Providers (CSP) belonging to 100 villages situated in the District of Sirajganj. These project participants will form entrepreneur groups/MSME which will in turn be linked to 50 Rural Service Centres 20 Community Facility Centres and 2 women-led civil society organisations.The indirect target group includes a population of at least 15,000 farmers from rural communities who will benefit from improved service delivery and the offer of Community Service Prodivders (CSPs)in the target areas of Chanagacha, Khoksabari, Kalia Haripur and Ratankandi Unions under the Sirajganj Sadar Upazila of Sirajganj district.
